name: Tardy
summary: Tardy is a first-person Sonic fangame with an emphasis on fast-paced chaos. You play as Nicky as he is running late to his first period class with Mr. Kintobor situated at the other end of the school. Kintobor isn't the patient type, however, and has sent his legion of hall monitors to capture Nicky in advance. It certainly doesn't help that the entire school itself constantly shifts its layout so it is not the same journey for every visit. Reach Kintobor's classroom on time without being caught by his lackeys so you can FINALLY sleep through his boring lectures.
